# KampongShare help

## Site rules

- KampongShare is a community donation and volunteer platform for Singapore. Local organizations post what they need; people donate items or volunteer at events.
- Individual accounts can donate, volunteer, or both, on one account. Organization and admin accounts can't donate or volunteer. Nobody can sign up as an admin.
- Signing up needs a name, email, password, agreeing to the Privacy Notice and confirming you are 18 or older. Phone, postal code and area are optional. We never ask for NRIC/FIN, date of birth, race, religion, income, health information or photos of people.
- Donating: open Browse needs, press Offer on one item and choose how many (never more than is still needed). One active offer per item; to change the amount, cancel and offer again. The organization accepts or declines. Once accepted, the drop-off instructions show on the donor dashboard under "Ready to drop off". The organization marks it delivered; a request becomes fulfilled when everything is delivered.
- When a request is closed, its waiting offers are declined automatically ("Request closed"); accepted offers still go ahead.
- What can be donated: food, clothing, hygiene, household, baby and education items that organizations ask for, following the general rules below and each request's own rules (size, material, condition and other details such as "Halal-certified only"). Before suggesting a donation plan, an AI checker compares each item with these rules: it matches, leaves out a pairing that clearly breaks a written rule (saying which rule), or asks the donor a yes/no question when it depends on the label, size or condition. The "What can I donate?" section on Browse needs (/needs.html) lists the general rules.
- Volunteering: an admin approves new volunteer accounts first; until then you can only browse events. Then press Volunteer on an event; the organization approves each application. You can withdraw while it is waiting; once approved, contact the organization if you can't make it. When an event has all the volunteers it needs it shows "Event full".
- Organizations: sign up as an organization, fill in the organization details, and wait for an admin to approve it. Then post requests (items, quantities, deadline, drop-off instructions) and events. An admin checks every request and event before the public sees it. After approval, a request's quantities, deadline, urgency and drop-off instructions can still change; its title, description and items can't. Closing a request can include a reason; cancelling an event needs a reason that volunteers will see. Requests still waiting for approval, and events nobody applied to, can be deleted.
- Organizations see a donor's or volunteer's contact details only after that person makes an offer to them or applies to their event. The public never sees donors' or volunteers' names or contact details.
- AI: each request gets an urgency score from a clear formula (deadline, how much is still needed, the organization's own urgency). The AI only explains the score and helps match what people can give. AI results are labelled "AI-suggested", the AI never receives personal details, and people always make the decisions.
- History: past offers, applications, requests and events stay in a History tab for 12 months.
- Accounts: sign up on the Sign up page (/signup.html); log in on the Log in page (/login.html) with email and password; log out from the Account menu at the top right. Forgot or reset a password: press "Forgot password?" on the Log in page (/login.html), or go straight to the Forgot password page (/forgot-password.html), enter your email, and open the link in the email to choose a new password (the link works once, for 1 hour; the page never says whether an account exists). Change a password while logged in: the Password section on the Profile page (/profile.html). Pinny (the chat helper) can search public requests and events and prepare drafts (an offer, a volunteer application or a message), but never sends anything: the person checks a draft and presses its button (Confirm application or Send) with their own login; an offer draft has "Complete offer", which opens the offer form to add the condition, a description and photos before sending; visitors log in first. Exact item details: each item has a size or specification, maybe a material, an accepted condition (New, Like new or better, Good or better, Fair or better, or Any condition) and other details (e.g. Halal-certified only), shown on the notice and in the request's details. To offer, press Offer on the item, choose how many, choose the condition (only conditions that meet the requirement are shown), describe the item if the organization asks, and add 1–3 photos of the actual item (location data is removed; only that organization and admins can see them). The organization compares what was needed with what was offered before accepting. The Profile page (/profile.html) lets you change your name, phone, postal code, area, donating/volunteering, availability, interests and skills (press Save changes), withdraw your consent, and see your data. Your email can't be changed on the site. People who donate or volunteer can delete their own account on the Profile page ("Delete my account", tick "I understand this can't be undone"): it removes the login, details and applications, cancels waiting offers, and keeps past donations without the name. Organization and admin accounts can't be deleted there: email the address shown in the Privacy Notice.
- Messages: logged-in donors and volunteers can message any approved organization with the "Message organization" button on its page, its events and its requests (at most 5 new conversations a day). Organizations can message only donors who offered to them ("Message donor") and volunteers who applied to their events ("Message volunteer"). Donors and volunteers can't message each other. Conversations are on the Messages page (/messages.html, the speech-bubble button in the top bar shows the unread number). Text only, up to 1000 characters. Only the two people in a conversation can read it; either side can block it (no new messages) or report a message, and admins read a message only if it is reported. "Delete conversation" (in the conversation's menu) removes it from your own inbox only: the other person keeps their copy, and a new message from them brings it back with only the new messages. Messages are kept for 12 months. A message in a different language from yours is translated automatically by AI (phone numbers, emails and links are removed first; each message is translated once); you can always see the original, and turn automatic translation off on the Messages page. Donations are always free: never send money, bank details or passwords.
- Languages: the site can be used in English, Simplified Chinese (中文) and Malay (Bahasa Melayu). Change it with the globe button in the top bar; the choice is remembered in this browser.
- Pages: Browse needs (/needs.html), Sign up (/signup.html), Log in (/login.html), Profile (/profile.html), Messages (/messages.html), How it works (/#how-heading), Privacy Notice (/privacy.html).

## What can be donated (general rules)

- Food must be sealed, unopened and not expired.
- No cooked or home-made food.
- No medicines, supplements or medical items.
- No alcohol, tobacco, vapes or e-cigarettes.
- No weapons, fireworks, gas canisters or other dangerous items.
- Electrical items must be safe and working, with a Singapore 3-pin (type G) plug.
- Clothing and bedding must be clean, with no stains, holes or mould.
- Baby items must be sealed or in safe, complete condition.
- The item must be the kind of thing the request asks for.

## Questions and answers

### How do I donate?

Find a request you can help with, then press Offer on one item. Check its size and condition, say how many you can give, choose your item's condition and add 1–3 photos of it. The organization accepts or declines your offer. Once it's accepted, you'll see where and when to drop it off. You need a free account to offer.

### How do I volunteer?

Sign up and tick "I want to volunteer". An admin checks new volunteer accounts first. Once you're approved, open an event and press Volunteer. The organization then confirms your place. While you wait, you can still browse all the events.

### How do offers work?

An offer is your promise to give a number of one item, never more than is still needed. You can have one active offer per item; to change the amount, cancel it and offer again. The organization accepts or declines it. If a request closes, waiting offers are declined automatically, but accepted ones still go ahead. After a request's deadline, it takes no new offers.

### What happens after a deadline?

Each request can have a deadline. After that day (Singapore time), it stops taking new offers and disappears from the lists. Offers already made can still be accepted, and accepted ones are still delivered. Events work the same way: once an event ends, it leaves the map and takes no new volunteers. Organizations can extend a deadline or close the request.

### What can I donate?

Only what organizations ask for: food, clothing, hygiene, household, baby and education items. Food must be sealed, unopened and not past its expiry date — you'll tick a box to confirm this. Cooked or home-made food isn't accepted, and neither are medicines. Clothing should be clean and in good condition.

### How does drop-off work?

Each request has drop-off instructions from the organization, like an address and opening hours. Once your offer is accepted, they appear clearly on your dashboard under "Ready to drop off". Bring the items there, and the organization marks them delivered.

### Can I donate and volunteer with one account?

Yes! One account can do both. Tick both when you sign up, or turn the other one on later in your profile. You'll then see a switch in the top bar to move between Donating and Volunteering. Turning on volunteering means an admin checks your volunteer account first.

### How do I post a request?

Once an admin has approved your organization, go to Requests and press "New donation request". Add a title, the items and quantities you need, a deadline and drop-off instructions. An admin checks every request before donors can see it. After the deadline, donors can't make new offers; you can extend it from your Overview.

### Why is my request waiting for approval?

An admin checks every new request before it goes public, to keep the platform safe and accurate. This usually doesn't take long. If it's rejected, you'll see the admin's note explaining what to change. While it's waiting, you can still edit or delete it.

### How do I accept offers?

Open Offers. Each offer shows the item, the amount and the donor's contact details, so you can arrange drop-off. Press Accept or Reject. When the items arrive, press "Mark delivered". The request becomes fulfilled automatically once everything has been delivered.

### How do I cancel an event?

Open Events and press "Cancel event". You'll need to give a short reason, because approved volunteers and anyone with the event's link will see it. If nobody has applied yet, you can delete the event instead.

### How do I sign up?

Press Sign up and choose whether you're an individual or an organization. Individuals tick "I want to donate", "I want to volunteer" or both. You'll need your name, email and a password, and you must agree to the Privacy Notice and confirm you're 18 or older. Phone, postal code and area are optional.

### How do I log in or log out?

To log in, press Log in at the top and enter your email and password. To log out, open the Account menu at the top right and press Log out.

### I forgot my password

Press "Forgot password?" on the Log in page and enter your email. We'll send you a link to choose a new password; it works once, for 1 hour. Already logged in? You can change your password on your Profile.

### How do I change my details?

Open your Profile. You can change your name, phone, postal code and area, turn donating or volunteering on or off, and update when you're free, your interests and skills. Then press Save changes. Your email can't be changed on the site yet.

### How do I delete my account?

If you donate or volunteer: open your Profile, go to "Delete my account", tick "I understand this can't be undone" and confirm. This removes your login, details and applications; past donations stay with organizations without your name. Organization accounts can't be deleted there — please email us using the address in the Privacy Notice.

### How does the AI work?

Each request gets an urgency score from a clear formula: how close the deadline is, how much is still needed, and the organization's own urgency. The AI only explains the score in plain words and helps match what you can give. It never sees anyone's personal details. Everything it suggests is labelled "AI-suggested", and people always make the decisions.

### Who checks the requests?

Our admins. They approve every organization before it can post anything, and every request and event before the public can see it. If something looks wrong later, they can close it or cancel it.

### How is my information protected?

You can read how we handle your information in our Privacy Notice.

### I have 3 bags of rice — where is it needed, and can I help this weekend?

Pinny looks up who needs rice and which events this weekend still have spots, then prepares drafts you can check and confirm.

### Find a volunteer event near Toa Payoh with spots left

Pinny searches upcoming events near Toa Payoh, checks how many spots are left, and can prepare an application for you to confirm.
